description: Audit the text of product listings: images without alt text, descriptions copied between products, descriptions that are too short and title problems. Use it for "which products have no alt text?", "are any descriptions duplicated?". Pass csv or domain, not both, and optionally min_words (default 20). Returns the four lists (each up to 100 entries) with totals before the cut. Domain mode reads the store's public product feed once after its robots.txt. Nothing is stored: the file or feed is used for this answer and dropped.

csv.description: The product CSV text exactly as exported from Shopify, header row included. At most 2 MB.

domain.description: A store address such as example.com, instead of csv. The store's public /products.json is read once (at most 5 pages of 250 products), after its robots.txt. Large stores often block it.

min_words.description: A description with fewer words than this counts as thin (default 20)

name: listing_text_audit

feed_truncated.description: True when the store has more products than the five pages read

host.description: The store read, in domain mode

totals.description: Counts before each list was cut to 100

title: Audit product listing text
